comment: Era-scoped principal mapping (PR-A2.1). Data, not code: every rule that
names a person lives HERE, keyed by speaker, and the matching logic in
principals.py is computed identically for every speaker (invariant I3:
relational use of identity, never conditional). A domain is SELF for a
speaker only while the utterance date falls inside one of that speaker's
eras — whitehouse.gov is SELF for Barack Obama on 2014-01-28 and
INDEPENDENT for any other speaker on the same date.
The *.archives.gov mirrors are listed per administration because that is
where each White House's live content moves after the term ends —
retrieval for a 2014 claim returns obamawhitehouse.archives.gov URLs.
end=null means an era that is still open at config-write time.
